from collections import Counter

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find divider: full row/col of a single non-bg color
    orient=pos=fcol=None
    for i in range(h):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg: fcol,orient,pos=g[i][0],'h',i
    for j in range(w):
        if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] for i in range(h)) and len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and g[0][j]!=bg:
            fcol,orient,pos=g[0][j],'v',j
    other=[c for c in cnt if c not in (bg,fcol)][0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==other]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if orient=='h':
        rows=[i for i,_ in cells]; ext=max(rows)-min(rows)+1
        # shape above divider -> line above shape side? line between shape and divider at pos-(ext+1)
        near = max(rows) if max(rows)<pos else min(rows)
        side = -1 if max(rows)<pos else 1
        newpos = pos + side*(ext+1)
        if 0<=newpos<h: out[newpos]=[8]*w
    else:
        cols=[j for _,j in cells]; ext=max(cols)-min(cols)+1
        side = -1 if max(cols)<pos else 1
        newpos = pos + side*(ext+1)
        if 0<=newpos<w:
            for i in range(h): out[i][newpos]=8
    return out

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    orient=pos=fcol=None
    for i in range(h):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg: fcol,orient,pos=g[i][0],'h',i
    if orient is None:
        for j in range(w):
            if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and g[0][j]!=bg: fcol,orient,pos=g[0][j],'v',j
    other=[c for c in cnt if c not in (bg,fcol)][0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==other]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def move(lo,hi,P):
        # return shift so shape touches divider P, shape on whichever side
        if lo>P: return (P+1)-lo   # shape right/below: move toward divider
        if hi<P: return (P-1)-hi   # shape left/above
        return 0
    if orient=='h':
        rows=[i for i,_ in cells]; ext=max(rows)-min(rows)+1
        sh=move(min(rows),max(rows),pos)
        newcells={(i+sh,j) for i,j in cells}
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in newcells: out[i][j]=other
        side = -1 if max(i for i,_ in newcells)<pos else 1
        lr = pos+side*(ext+1)
        if 0<=lr<h: out[lr]=[8]*w
    else:
        cols=[j for _,j in cells]; ext=max(cols)-min(cols)+1
        sh=move(min(cols),max(cols),pos)
        newcells={(i,j+sh) for i,j in cells}
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in newcells: out[i][j]=other
        side = -1 if max(j for _,j in newcells)<pos else 1
        lc = pos+side*(ext+1)
        if 0<=lc<w:
            for i in range(h): out[i][lc]=8
    return out
